rows.Benefit Description.Outpatient facility: • Operating, recovery, observation, and other treatment rooms • Prescribed drugs and medications • Diagnostic laboratory tests, x-rays, and pathology services • Administration of blood, blood plasma, and other biologicals • Blood or blood plasma, if not donated or replaced • Pre-surgical testing • Dressings, casts, and sterile tray services • Medical supplies, including oxygen • Anesthetics and anesthesia service • Outpatient cardiac and pulmonary rehabilitation, 36 visits maximum each per year • Respiratory and inhalation therapies • In Lab Attended Polysomnography (sleep study) - Requires preauthorization • CT, MRI, MRA, Nuclear Cardiology and PET studies - Preauthorization is required for these tests. • Non-routine colonoscopy - See Section 5(a), professional fees, and 5(b), surgical fees, for applicable charges • Other major - minor diagnostic test(s) Notes: • If your in-network provider uses an out-of-network lab, imaging facility or radiologist, we will pay out-of-network benefits for lab and radiology charges. • We cover hospital services and supplies related to dental procedures when necessitated by a non-dental physical impairment. We do not cover the dental procedures.
rows.You pay After the calendar year deductib: In-network: 5% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 35% of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount

rows.Benefit Description.Outpatient facility: Not covered: • Maintenance cardiac and pulmonary rehabilitation • Services that are related to a non-covered surgery or procedure

Maternity care - Outpatient hospital or birth center Here are some things to keep in mind: • You do not need to precertify your normal delivery; see Section 3, Maternity care, for other circumstances, such as extended stays for you or your baby. • You may remain in the hospital up to 48 hours after a regular delivery and 96 hours after a cesarean delivery. We will cover an extended stay if medically necessary, but you must precertify. • We cover routine nursery care of the newborn child during the covered portion of the mother's maternity stay.
rows.You pay After the calendar year deductib: In-network: Nothing Out-of-network: 35% of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount
